mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as long as the rate remains below 2.0%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle supply expansion, rising industrial production above 105 index indicates improving manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during early-cycle supply expansion (INDPRO > 105), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales trend over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as long as the trend persists.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising retail sales periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and growth in employment signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is declining and PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 110 index signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
